name: Patient and Staff Experience
description: Next.js pages, shared styling, and accessible React components present the synthetic bill, bilingual voice and text conversation, deterministic arithmetic, and staff-visible workflow timeline.

name: Authenticated Server API
description: Next.js route handlers enforce the signed BeneBot session boundary while exposing the closed bill, benefits, resources, follow-up, summary, and temporary Deepgram-token operations.

name: Deterministic Billing and Trust Core
description: Pure billing normalization and reconciliation, shared contracts, scoped JWT sessions, and sanitized errors keep financial explanations deterministic and patient access fail-closed.

name: Bilingual Voice and Conversation Policy
description: Deepgram configuration, the English/Spanish billing dictionary, tool prerequisites, deterministic fallback routing, and the closed tool bridge govern every spoken or typed conversation.

name: Healthcare Integrations and FHIR Workflow
description: Server-only adapters validate configuration, read and write scoped Medplum FHIR R4 resources, refresh timestamped Stedi eligibility, and search disclosure-preserving support resources.

name: Synthetic Demo and Evaluation Evidence
description: FHIR fixtures, guarded Stedi inputs, bilingual resource catalogs, adjudicated concept packets, and transcript cases provide the safe synthetic evidence used by the demo and its reliability checks.

name: Verification and Conversation Evaluation
description: Executable rubrics plus unit, integration, and browser tests prove the reconciled bill math, security boundaries, bilingual behavior, external-workflow confirmation, and full Jane Doe happy path.

name: Product, Safety, and Delivery Documentation
description: The canonical specification, repository policies, research prompts, reliability plan, runbook, and execution guides preserve BeneBot's synthetic-only scope and historical-versus-current evidence boundary.

name: Build, Test, Analysis, and Seed Tooling
description: Strict TypeScript, Next.js, Tailwind, Vitest, Playwright, lint, knowledge-graph, package, and idempotent Medplum seed controls make the demo reproducible and inspectable.
